entries.title: Psalms 136:1
segments: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah, for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:2
segments: Give thanks unto the God of gods, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:3
segments: Give thanks unto the Lord of lords, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:4
segments: To him who alone doeth great wonders, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:5
segments: To him that by understanding made the heavens, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:6
segments: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:7
segments: To him that made great lights, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:8
segments: The sun for rule over the day, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:9
segments: The moon and stars for rule over the night, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:10
segments: ¶To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:11
segments: And brought out Israel from among them, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:12
segments: With a powerful hand and with a stretched-out arm, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:13
segments: To him that divided the Red sea into parts, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:14
segments: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:15
segments: And overturned Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:16
segments: To him that led his people through the wilderness, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:17
segments: To him that smote great kings, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:18
segments: And slew famous kings, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:19
segments: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:20
segments: And Og king of Bashan, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:21
segments: And gave their land for an inheritance, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,

entries.title: Psalms 136:22
segments: An inheritance unto Israel his servant, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:23
segments: ¶Who hath remembered us in our low estate, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:24
segments: And hath delivered us from our oppressors, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:25
segments: Who giveth food to all flesh, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:26
segments: Give ye thanks unto the *God of the heavens; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
